meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能按 anndata 的正确 API 处理注释数据矩阵：创建、读取、写入 .h5ad/.zarr 文件，支持子集、合并、转置、类型转换等操作，并遵循推荐用法。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad 文件、操作 AnnData 对象，或与 scverse 生态工具（如 scanpy）集成时触发。

say.text: 把这三个 .h5ad 文件按 obs 合并，加一列 batch 标签。
把这个 AnnData 对象用 gzip 压缩保存为 .h5ad 文件。
say.note: Claude 会以 gzip 压缩写入 h5ad 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle annotated data matrices using AnnData APIs: create, read, write .h5ad/.zarr files, subset/merge/transpose/convert data, and follow recommended practices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with .h5ad files, manipulating AnnData objects, or integrating with scverse ecosystem tools like scanpy.

say_en.text: Read this .h5ad file with anndata and show obs/var column names.

say_en.text: Concatenate these three .h5ad files by obs, adding a batch column.
say_en.note: Claude uses ad.concat with label set.
